purpose: Measure explicit joint Apple Neural Engine and Metal execution without weakening MLX checkpoint, replay, numerical, or host-safety authority.

source_prior_art.use: Private-API ANE kernel, dynamic-weight, backward, IOSurface, and CPU-gradient research reference; no source imported.
Output-channel ANE+GPU split reference and negative evidence that eager synchronization and host copies erase end-to-end gains; no source imported.
Inference-only reference for IOSurface-backed buffers, serial ANE submission, ping-pong state, graph chunking, and moving argmax/top-k before the device boundary; no training or source-import claim.

coreml_all_inference_baseline.placement_authority: Core ML compute plan and runtime profiling
coreml_all_inference_baseline.claim_boundary: Automatic graph partitioning is opaque and does not establish simultaneous ANE+GPU execution.

explicit_output_channel_split.forward: ANE and Metal compute disjoint output-channel partitions concurrently, then concatenate without a host round trip.
explicit_output_channel_split.backward: Partition-local weight gradients retain exact parameter ownership; input-gradient partitions are summed before upstream use.

microbatch_pipeline.scope: training overlap candidate after split-linear parity
microbatch_pipeline.schedule: Overlap ANE forward/input-gradient work for one microbatch with Metal weight-gradient, optimizer, or independent microbatch work.
microbatch_pipeline.requirement: Versioned weights and gradients must prevent stale-read or mixed-generation publication.

compile_once_dynamic_ane.transport: Pack the current FP16 compute weights beside activations in IOSurface inputs so one shape-specific MIL graph can be compiled once and reused across optimizer generations.
compile_once_dynamic_ane.authority: One FP32 master parameter generation remains authoritative; every ANE input surface is tagged with that generation and may not survive publication of the next generation.
compile_once_dynamic_ane.claim_boundary: Mutable-weight transport is proven on this M1. The audited research trainer's model, loss, vocabulary, optimizer, and batching semantics are not Theseus semantics.

public_coreml_state_weight_probe.scope: bounded fail-stable alternative to private mutable-weight transport
public_coreml_state_weight_probe.mechanism: Represent FP16 compute weights as Core ML state tensors, update one MLState per authoritative generation, and inspect the compute plan plus runtime placement for ANE-resident matmul.
public_coreml_state_weight_probe.claim_boundary: Core ML state is public and mutable, but Apple documents it as prediction state and provides no general transformer backward. This is a forward/input transport probe, not a training solution by itself.

synchronous_heterogeneous_data_parallel.scope: preferred end-to-end training topology after exact ANE model parity
synchronous_heterogeneous_data_parallel.schedule: Dispatch disjoint microbatch shards from one sampler/update batch to MLX/Metal and ANE concurrently, accumulate both gradient trees in FP32, apply one global normalization and clip, then publish one AdamW update.
forbidden: different sampler rows or objective weights
loss normalization by device rather than total authority mass
checkpoint publication before both gradient contributions join
synchronous_heterogeneous_data_parallel.reason: Independent microbatches expose the most device parallelism without inserting a synchronization boundary inside every transformer layer.

ane_forward_dx_metal_dw_pipeline.scope: preferred intra-step kernel split if full-model ANE data parallel is not yet faster
ane_forward_dx_metal_dw_pipeline.schedule: ANE computes projection forward and input gradients while Metal computes the corresponding weight gradients, output/loss, pointer operations, and the eventual single optimizer update from shared IOSurface generations.
ane_forward_dx_metal_dw_pipeline.reason: The audited dynamic trainer already overlaps ANE work with CPU BLAS dW; moving dW to Metal targets that measured dependency while avoiding a wide activation concatenation.

inference_handoff.scope: after a qualified model checkpoint exists
inference_handoff.public_baseline: Core ML computeUnits=all with compute-plan inspection
inference_handoff.private_candidate: ANE-prefill and stateful decode with IOSurface ping-pong buffers; keep sampling or other independent work on Metal only when joined latency and energy improve.
inference_handoff.boundary_reduction: Evaluate in-model argmax/top-k and chunk-local reductions so full-vocabulary tensors do not cross ANE-to-host boundaries.
inference_handoff.training_priority: Inference work may reuse training kernels and tensor layouts, but cannot delay the semantics-qualified training route.

shared_surface_contract.writer_rule: Exactly one of host, Metal, or ANE may write a surface generation, and no reader may be active while a writer is active.
shared_surface_contract.reader_rule: Metal and ANE may concurrently read a sealed immutable generation.
shared_surface_contract.publication_rule: Only a fully joined, parity-checked generation may become checkpoint-visible.

fp16_range_policy.function_preserving_reparameterization_c: Only if a preregistered activation-range probe observes an FP16 overflow risk; require forward, backward, optimizer, checkpoint, and heldout equivalence before adoption.
fp16_range_policy.reason: ANE compute is FP16. A paired weight/residual reparameterization may preserve the function while reducing peak activations, whereas runtime clipping changes the function.

dynamic_training.claim_scope: Compiler, mutable-weight transport, finite-gradient, resource, GQA-grouping, and process-overlap mechanics only.

process_coexistence.claim_scope: Independent useful workloads only; no shared tensor or end-to-end training claim.

same_surface_visibility.claim_scope: Metal-write to ANE-read plus concurrent immutable reads on one IOSurface generation; partitioned linear math, no-copy join, and MLX lazy integration remain open.
